macros.name: embedfile
macros.doc: The macro \embedfile includes file ⟨file⟩ and attaches it to the PDF document.

macros.name: embedfilefield
macros.doc: Macro \embedfilefield defines a column/field in the collection table.

macros.name: embedfilegetobject
macros.doc: Macro \embedfilegetobject expands to the full object reference object of ⟨type⟩ for the embedded file identified by ⟨id⟩.

macros.name: embedfileifobjectexists
macros.doc: Macro \embedfileifobjectexists tests whether object of ⟨type⟩ is available for the embedded file identified by ⟨id⟩.

macros.name: embedfilesetup
macros.doc: Options for \embedfile and collection support can be set in \embedfilesetup.

macros.name: embedfilesort
macros.doc: The sort order of the embedded files are controlled by macro \embedfilesort.
